author: Zegita
body:
During matches either in public or competitive arrows cannot go through your teamates and this really sucks. When you're together as a group in say a small-medium map and you're trying to shoot at the enemy, you can not hit them because the arrow hits onto the teamate and so it does not register. On OCN for example, when you shoot an arrow at an enemy and a teamate is infront of you, the arrow goes through to the teamate to then hit the opposing enemy and this works very well and it means that you do not waste arrows as you hit your teamates and so it doesn't affect anything.

Devs if you read this please add this to your priorities - it causes a lot of nuisance and it is very hard to kill the enemy if it is say a corridor and everyone is clamped together. Thanks :^)
